title: Automation R&D Lab Associate
description:
**About us:**


Nomic was founded with the purpose of making biology easier to measure. To do this, we have untangled some of the most difficult problems in protein profiling. Our team is combining DNA nanotechnology, high\-dimensional flow cytometry, laboratory automation, and machine learning to develop the world’s highest throughput proteomic platform: the nELISA.


Since spinning out of McGill University, we have partnered with and provided platform access to dozens of drug discovery groups including GSK, 4 of the top 10 pharmas, and leading biotechs. We have recently launched a state of the art manufacturing and protein profiling facility that enables multiplexed measurement of \>2\.5M samples a year, generating an effective 500M protein assays in the process.


We are building a diverse team of engineers, scientists, and world\-changers. We like to break down difficult problems using a first principles approach, often leveraging the latest breakthroughs from across the scientific and technological spectrum to drive our mission forward.


Nomic is headquartered in Montreal, Canada with a satellite research lab in Boston, Massachusetts. The majority of our team is based in Montreal and works in a new, shared office/laboratory space, and our Boston team is quickly growing with a focus on automation and core nELISA platform R\&D.

**About the role:**


Our Automation team’s mission is to drive operational excellence through innovative robotic and process improvements, on both the manufacturing and profiling side of our nELISA platform. As an R\&D Lab Associate on the Automation team, you’ll contribute to developing workflow improvements that utilize automation equipment to improve the efficiency and consistency of your fellow departments at Nomic. Your role will directly help accelerate work on our nELISA platform. In particular:

* This role will involve a mixture of bench work and automated experimentation, as well as substantial general lab work and day\-to\-day lab management, such as organizing and recording consumables, monitoring and running QC experiments for key equipment, and documenting/organizing activities together with your Automation teammates.
* You’ll collaborate with most teams across Nomic, ranging from R\&D teams for experimental design, to our software team for developing user interfaces.
* You will also independently plan and execute more focused R\&D experiments, and work with other departments to take any insights and iterate on the design of subsequent experiments.
* You will execute experiments that require the use of advanced liquid handlers and cytometers, as well as more common lab equipment. Using these instruments you’ll also manufacture molecular nELISA subcomponents to perform well\-controlled lab experiments.
* You’ll work with your Automation teammates to observe internal lab operations, suggesting ways in which the automation department can help reduce painful protocol steps and improve reliability.
* You’ll collaborate across Nomic’s Montreal and Boston sites, and communicate with lab operators who are performing robot protocols remotely.
* In addition to day\-to\-day work on process improvement, you’ll contribute to supporting deployed processes, working with our manufacturing and profiling teams to help troubleshoot issues they may encounter.

**What we’re looking for:**

* 3\+ years of hands\-on independent wet lab R\&D experience in bioscience domain.
* Masters in a Biology, Bioengineering, or a related bioscience or engineering field, or equivalent experience in industry.
* A love for carrying out lab work at the bench and keeping a lab organized and operational.
* Knowledge of Liquid Handlers and Automation equipment, including experience transferring protocols from hands\-on bench scale to more automated protocols.
* Strong scientific technical understanding of your previous wet lab biology R\&D projects.
* Experience working closely within a wet lab research and development team, and competency in experimental design and iteration.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

**Join us if you:**

* Connect deeply with our mission, ambition and sense of duty. Our mission isn’t marketing flash: we developed our technology to better measure biology and discover biomarkers for early disease detection. We firmly believe we will be successful in literally eradicating certain diseases by enabling them to be diagnosed earlier. We also believe that our hard work to bring this technology to its full potential is our duty.
* Are up for a challenge and want to grow: We are a team of problem\-solvers, and we continually put ourselves to the test and go into the unknown. We have a growth mindset, both on hard and soft skills, and we rely on each other to give critical and candid feedback to ensure that we can all reach our full potential.
* Want to be at the cutting\-edge of biotechnology. The nELISA is a new tool that leverages DNA nanotechnology to generate proteomic data more efficiently than ever before. You get to design, build and run the system that will run the technology going forward.
* Love hands\-on lab work, and want to take hold of key learnings from experiments, and use them to develop improved analytical methods to ensure the robust biological validation of immunoassays.
* Prefer working and communicating within a diverse cross\-functional team. You would get to interface with teammates from the Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams on a daily basis, joining a collaborative, diverse, and inclusive team where your ideas will be valued.


If you are passionate about lab work, want to drive innovation in proteomics, and are eager to make a meaningful impact in the world, we invite you to apply and join us on our journey to redefine proteomics and the understanding of biology.

**À propos de nous:**


Nomic a été fondée dans le but de rendre la biologie plus facile à mesurer. Pour ce faire, nous avons démêlé certains des problèmes les plus difficiles dans le profilage des protéines. Notre équipe combine la nanotechnologie ADN, la cytométrie en flux à haute dimension, l'automatisation des laboratoires et l'apprentissage automatique pour développer la plateforme de protéomique la plus performante au monde : la nELISA.


Depuis que nous avons émergé de l'Université McGill, nous avons collaboré et fourni l'accès à notre plateforme à des dizaines de groupes de découverte de médicaments, tels que GSK, 4 des 10 plus grandes entreprises pharmaceutiques et des entreprises de biotechnologie de premier plan. Nous avons récemment mis sur pied une technologie innovatrice de fabrication et de profilage de protéines qui permet la mesure multiplexée de plus de 2,5 millions d'échantillons par année, ce qui génère concrètement 500 millions d'analyse de protéines au courant du processus.


Nous constituons une équipe diversifiée d'ingénieurs, de scientifiques et de changeurs du monde. Nous aimons décomposer les problèmes difficiles en utilisant une approche de principes fondamentaux, souvent en exploitant les plus récentes avancées scientifiques et technologiques pour faire progresser notre mission.


Nomic a son siège social à Montréal, au Canada, avec un laboratoire de recherche satellite à Boston, dans le Massachusetts. La majorité de notre équipe est basée à Montréal et travaille dans un nouvel espace de bureau/laboratoire partagé, tandis que notre équipe de Boston se développe rapidement, avec un focus sur l'automatisation et la recherche et développement de la plateforme nELISA.

**À propos du poste:**


L'objectif de notre équipe d'automatisation est de favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle grâce à des améliorations innovantes des processus et de la robotique, tant du côté de la fabrication que de la caractérisation de notre plateforme nELISA. En tant qu'Associé(e) en R\&D au sein de l'équipe d'automatisation, vous contribuerez au développement d'améliorations des flux de travail en utilisant des équipements d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité et la cohérence des départements de Nomic. Votre rôle aidera directement à accélérer les travaux sur notre plateforme nELISA. En particulier :

* Ce rôle impliquera une combinaison de travail au banc et d'expérimentations automatisées, ainsi qu'un travail substantiel en laboratoire général et la gestion quotidienne du laboratoire, comme l'organisation et l'enregistrement des consommables, la surveillance et la réalisation d'expériences de contrôle de qualité pour les équipements clés, et la documentation/organisation des activités avec vos coéquipiers en automatisation.
* Vous collaborerez avec la plupart des équipes de Nomic, allant des équipes de R\&D pour la conception d'expérimentations, à notre équipe logicielle pour le développement des interfaces utilisateur.
* Vous planifierez et exécuterez également de manière autonome des expériences R\&D plus ciblées, et travaillerez avec d'autres départements pour tirer parti des enseignements tirés et itérer sur la conception des expériences suivantes.
* Vous exécuterez des expériences nécessitant l'utilisation de manipulateurs de liquides avancés et de cytomètres, ainsi que d'équipements de laboratoire plus courants. En utilisant ces instruments, vous fabriquerez également des sous\-composants moléculaires nELISA pour réaliser des expériences contrôlées en laboratoire.
* Vous travaillerez avec vos coéquipiers en automatisation pour observer les opérations internes du laboratoire, en suggérant des moyens par lesquels le département d'automatisation peut aider à réduire les étapes de protocoles complexes et améliorer la fiabilité.
* Vous collaborerez entre les sites de Nomic à Montréal et à Boston, et communiquerez avec les opérateurs de laboratoire qui exécutent des protocoles robotiques à distance.
* En plus du travail quotidien sur l'amélioration des processus, vous contribuerez à soutenir les processus déployés, en travaillant avec nos équipes de fabrication et de caractérisation pour les aider à résoudre les problèmes qu'ils pourraient rencontrer.

**Ce que nous recherchons :**

* Plus de 3 ans d'expérience pratique et indépendante en R\&D en laboratoire humide dans le domaine des biosciences
* Master en Biologie, Bioingénierie ou un domaine connexe des biosciences ou de l'ingénierie, ou expérience équivalente dans l'industrie
* Passion pour le travail en laboratoire et maintien d'un laboratoire organisé et opérationnel
* Connaissance des manipulateurs de liquides et des équipements d'automatisation, y compris l'expérience de transfert de protocoles de l'échelle du banc à des protocoles plus automatisés
* Solide compréhension technique scientifique des projets de R\&D en biologie réalisés en laboratoire humide
* Expérience de travail étroite au sein d'une équipe de R\&D en laboratoire humide, et compétence en conception et itération d'expériences
* Excellentes compétences en communication (verbale et écrite)

**Joignez\-vous à notre équipe si:**

* Notre mission vous stimule, répond à vos ambitions et votre sens du devoir. Notre mission n'est pas un simple coup de publicité : nous avons développé notre technologie pour mieux mesurer la biologie et découvrir des biomarqueurs pour la détection précoce des maladies. Nous croyons fermement que nous réussirons à éradiquer littéralement certaines maladies en permettant leur diagnostic plus tôt. Nous croyons également que notre travail acharné pour amener cette technologie à son plein potentiel est notre devoir.
* Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever un défi et à grandir : nous sommes une équipe de solutionneurs de problèmes, et nous nous mettons constamment à l'épreuve et plongeons dans l'inconnu. Nous avons une mentalité de croissance, tant sur les compétences techniques que générales, et nous comptons les uns sur les autres pour donner des retours critiques et francs afin de nous assurer que nous puissions tous atteindre notre plein potentiel.
* Vous souhaitez être à la pointe de la biotechnologie. La nELISA est un nouvel outil qui exploite la nanotechnologie ADN pour générer des données protéomiques plus efficacement que jamais auparavant. Vous aurez la possibilité de concevoir, de construire et d'exploiter le système qui soutiendra l'évolution de cette technologie.
* Vous aimez le travail pratique en laboratoire, souhaitez tirer parti des apprentissages clés des expériences et les utiliser pour développer des méthodes analytiques améliorées afin d'assurer la validation biologique robuste des immunoessais.
* Vous préférez travailler et communiquer au sein d'une équipe diversifiée et multi\-disciplinaire. Vous serez en contact avec des collègues des équipes d'ingénierie, des opérations et des équipes commerciales au quotidien, rejoignant une équipe collaborative, diversifiée et inclusive où vos idées seront valorisées.


Si vous êtes passionné(e) par le travail en laboratoire, souhaitez stimuler l'innovation en protéomique, et désirez avoir un impact significatif sur le monde, nous vous invitons à postuler et à nous rejoindre dans notre mission de redéfinir la protéomique et la compréhension de la biologie.

title: Hardware Engineering Manager (Teradyne, North Reading)
description:
We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next\-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost\-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

  

We attract, develop, and retain a high\-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

**Our Purpose**  

At Teradyne we are at the forefront of Production Board Test solutions, dedicated to developing cutting\-edge test solutions and systems. We are seeking a dynamic and hands\-on Hardware Engineering Manager to join our team. This role requires a blend of guidance and technical expertise, with a strong foundation in analog and digital circuit design and PCBA fabrication. The ideal candidate will thrive in a player/coach capacity, balancing leadership responsibilities while actively contributing to the design and development of high\-quality hardware products.  

  

**Opportunity Overview**


As a Hardware Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for spearheading a team of design engineers while actively participating in the development, prototyping, and testing of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and assemblies (PCBA). You will guide the team in meeting project goals, improving processes, and ensuring product reliability, while also contributing directly to hands\-on engineering tasks. Your experience in PCB design, fabrication, and test techniques will be crucial to ensuring the success of both your team and the hardware products we deliver. Another important element required for our success is continuous collaboration with other disciplines, particularly our software team, to deliver the total product solutions our customers demand.

  



* **Team Leadership \& Development:**
	+ Lead and mentor a team of hardware engineers, providing technical guidance, architectural direction and fostering a collaborative, innovative work environment.
	+ Set clear goals and performance expectations, manage team dynamics, and ensure high levels of engagement and productivity.
	+ Conduct regular performance reviews, offer constructive feedback, and identify opportunities for professional growth.
* **Hands\-On Engineering:**
	+ Actively contribute to the design, development, and testing of PCBs and PCBAs, with a focus on high\-quality, reliable designs.
	+ Oversee PCB layout, schematic design, and component selection to ensure designs meet performance and manufacturability standards.
	+ Participate in the testing and validation of PCBA, utilizing advanced test techniques such as functional, boundary scan, in\-circuit testing (ICT), and other diagnostic tools to ensure product quality.
* **Project Management:**
	+ Oversee hardware development projects from concept to production, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met while maintaining a high standard of quality.
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., firmware, software, and mechanical engineering) to ensure alignment and smooth project execution.
		- Provide regular updates to senior management on project status, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* **Process Improvement \& Innovation:**
	+ Identify areas for improvement in hardware design, testing, and manufacturing processes, and implement best practices to enhance product quality and engineering efficiency.
	+ Stay current with emerging hardware technologies, industry trends, and testing methodologies, and apply them to improve team capabilities and product offerings.
* **Customer Focus \& Quality Assurance:**
	+ Ensure that products meet or exceed customer requirements, industry standards, and regulatory compliance.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve hardware\-related issues in collaboration with the quality assurance and operations teams.

 **All About You**

**Experience:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in hardware engineering, with a strong background in PCB design and fabrication.
* 2\+ years in a managerial role, ideally in a player/coach capacity where both technical contribution and team management are required.
* Proven experience with PCBA test techniques such as functional testing, ICT, boundary scan, and other diagnostic methods\\

**Technical Skills:**

* Proficient in PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence, or similar).
* In\-depth understanding of PCB manufacturing processes, including design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for test (DFT).
* Strong understanding of electrical and electronic principles, circuit design, and signal integrity.
* Experience with hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, etc.).
* Knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to hardware design, testing, and quality assurance.

**Leadership \& Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage teams, collaborate cross\-functionally, and communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities and a proactive approach to overcoming challenges.
* Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high standards of work.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high\-speed PCB design and complex multi\-layer designs.
* Familiarity with automation and software\-driven testing methods for PCBA In\-Circuit Testing

 **Benefits:**

**Benefits**: Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well\-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more. At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll partake in meaningful work as part of a team that prioritizes performance, quality, and innovation. With revenues of more than $35 billion and the largest investment in R\&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create significant contributions to the world.

**Location/Division Specific Information**


The Chemical Analysis Division provides a broad mix of analytical instruments and services to a diverse range of end user markets including Safety \& Security, Environmental, Food Safety, Life Sciences, Medical, Energy, and Minerals and Mining. Its instruments are deployed globally in the field and on the line, in dynamic environments where customers put a premium on quality, reliability and ease of use. The CAD business operates within a global footprint with more than 2,000 colleagues, delivering product solutions to customers that allow for confident, on\-the\-spot decision making.

**How you will make an impact:**


As a Technical Support Product Specialist, you will provide product consultation to customers, channel partners, service personnel and other Business Unit partners. Applying different technologies through effective problem solving, you will help minimize disruption to our customer’s operations. You will collaborate with inter\-functional teams such as R\&D, depot repair, field service, customer service, and quality control to provide timely and accurate resolution to customer issues.

* Serve as the go\-to resource for resolving technical inquiries related to MAX instruments and software.
* Serve as the liaison between technical support and software and hardware engineering to resolve complex customer inquiries.
* Thoroughly document and handle all customer inquiries in Salesforce.
* Work closely with field service team for timely resolution of customer issues before, during and after instrument commissioning and field visits.
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues by demonstrating advanced analytical skills, detailed debugging, and a deep understanding of system integrations.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and support product innovation by assembling user feedback and recommending technical improvements.
* Partner with the sales team to demonstrate technical capabilities and address detailed technical questions from prospects.
* Adopt Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methods to find opportunities to enhance workflows, automate processes, and improve the overall efficiency of technical support team.

* Bachelors Degree in a Scientific Field required.

* Teammate, able to work efficiently with customers and colleagues in difficult and stressful situations
* Customer friendliness and a professional demeanour

* PC literacy including MS Office and Outlook.

In this role you will have extensive onboarding training to support your development. title: Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform, Large Molecule Research Platform (LMRP)
description:
**Job title**: Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform, Large Molecule Research Platform (LMRP)

**Location**: Cambridge, MA

**About the Job**


Are you ready to shape the future of medicine? The race is on to speed up drug discovery and development to find answers for patients and their families. Your skills could be critical in helping our teams accelerate progress.


The Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform in the Global Large Molecules Research Platform (LMRP) will be responsible for establishing and implementing the strategy for LMRP related to all digital and computational approaches for our discovery and engineering workflows. She/he will also be a key contributor to the platform’s long\-term strategy for sustainable and innovative biologics. Digital applications are central to our innovation approach and to the advancement of our biologics strategy. Our digital strategy begins with the core foundational approach to our data governance and includes advanced initiatives in Machine Learning and Artificial intelligence to improve our workflows and increase our ability to deliver first in class and best in class biologic drugs to the market. LMRP is a large global organization responsible for generating the biologic compounds entering the Sanofi pipeline. This organization consists of sites within Cambridge, MA (US); Vitry, France; Frankfurt, Germany; Ghent, Belgium; and Cambridge, UK. The Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform will directly manage a team in the five countries in which LMRP operates and will be responsible for working with key collaborators across Sanofi including all functions within Research, and Digital and Operations to advance the digital strategy for the LMRP organization. The Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform will co\-lead external strategic partnerships and ensure success of the collaborations. As a member of the LMRP leadership team, the Global Head of Digital Biologics Platform will manage the foundational digital approaches at all LMRP sites, set the LMR Digital AI innovation goals and targets, and execute on these. This role will report to the Head of Global Large Molecule Research Platform and is expected to have a strong impact on the platform’s portfolio and performance.


We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Defining and executing on LMRP’s data, digital and AI near\-, mid\-, long\-term strategy in support of Sanofi’s overall business strategy
* Building of next generation AI\-driven biologics discovery and design pipelines together with Digital and global LMRP consisting of the computational engine and requisite laboratory platform and automation technologies
* Establishing and implementing data governance and acquisition practices across LMR with the support of an imbedded direct report at each LMR site, in collaboration with the R\&D Data Office
* Developing the framework for foundational data exploitation: the base capabilities for exploiting data across LMR, including data and infrastructure for sustaining future advanced applications. This includes provisioning of tools, advocating for appropriate infrastructure and working with the LMR global organization on building expertise to expand use of data for daily decision making and operations, for monitoring platform performance, and for performing specific computational biology\-related functions (e.g. structure prediction/modeling, predictive modeling and data\-mining for discovery and drug design)
* Defining and implementing AI method validation, acceptance and operationalization processes with the goal of maintaining rigor in the practice of drug discovery, applying AI efficiently, and on applications with the most value
* Co\-managing data and ML operations together with Digital team to ensure state of the art computational platforms (e.g. enabling automated monitoring and update of predictive models with newly accumulated data)
* Leading the DBx (Digital Biologics) group which consists of a matrix organization of scientists across global LMR that are executing on digital initiatives across the spectrum from foundational to advanced AI applications
* Overseeing change management within the LMRP organization as it undergoes digital and AI transformation, including defining new Ways of Working and workforce upskilling
* Computational platform innovation: development of new or extension of computational platforms, as complement or alternative to lab platforms, covering benchmarking work, exploratory ML applications, upgrading computational infrastructure and methods (e.g. new software, higher throughput, greater performance (time), better accuracy and reliability)
* Working in close collaboration with the Head of Innovation to set the strategy and goals to ensure Sanofi attains a leadership position in biologics Innovation.
* Managing the portfolio of strategic external industry and academic collaborations, in partnership with Digital

**About You**

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* PhD in Biology, Chemistry, Computational sciences or related field
* Minimum 15 years of work experience in computational biology, or digital\-related discipline
* Strong leadership and management skills
* Demonstrated experience managing initiatives and projects in a complex, matrix organization
* Successful track record in leading projects and teams in Research
* Recognized thought leadership in the industry in the areas of digital transformation and drug discovery
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Effective interpersonal skills and ability to work transversally
* Project management experience

**Why Choose Us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.


Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employers committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Automation R&D Lab Associate
description:
**About us:**
 Nomic was founded with the purpose of making biology easier to measure. To do this, we have untangled some of the most difficult problems in protein profiling. Our team is combining DNA nanotechnology, high\-dimensional flow cytometry, laboratory automation, and machine learning to develop the world’s highest throughput proteomic platform: the nELISA.
   

  

 Since spinning out of McGill University, we have partnered with and provided platform access to dozens of drug discovery groups including GSK, 4 of the top 10 pharmas, and leading biotechs. We have recently launched a state of the art manufacturing and protein profiling facility that enables multiplexed measurement of \>2\.5M samples a year, generating an effective 500M protein assays in the process.
   

  

 We are building a diverse team of engineers, scientists, and world\-changers. We like to break down difficult problems using a first principles approach, often leveraging the latest breakthroughs from across the scientific and technological spectrum to drive our mission forward.
   

  

 Nomic is headquartered in Montreal, Canada with a satellite research lab in Boston, Massachusetts. The majority of our team is based in Montreal and works in a new, shared office/laboratory space, and our Boston team is quickly growing with a focus on automation and core nELISA platform R\&D.
   

  

**About the role:**
 Our Automation team’s mission is to drive operational excellence through innovative robotic and process improvements, on both the manufacturing and profiling side of our nELISA platform. As an R\&D Lab Associate on the Automation team, you’ll contribute to developing workflow improvements that utilize automation equipment to improve the efficiency and consistency of your fellow departments at Nomic. Your role will directly help accelerate work on our nELISA platform. In particular:
   

  

* This role will involve a mixture of bench work and automated experimentation, as well as substantial general lab work and day\-to\-day lab management, such as organizing and recording consumables, monitoring and running QC experiments for key equipment, and documenting/organizing activities together with your Automation teammates.
* You’ll collaborate with most teams across Nomic, ranging from R\&D teams for experimental design, to our software team for developing user interfaces.
* You will also independently plan and execute more focused R\&D experiments, and work with other departments to take any insights and iterate on the design of subsequent experiments.
* You will execute experiments that require the use of advanced liquid handlers and cytometers, as well as more common lab equipment. Using these instruments you’ll also manufacture molecular nELISA subcomponents to perform well\-controlled lab experiments.
* You’ll work with your Automation teammates to observe internal lab operations, suggesting ways in which the automation department can help reduce painful protocol steps and improve reliability.
* You’ll collaborate across Nomic’s Montreal and Boston sites, and communicate with lab operators who are performing robot protocols remotely.
* In addition to day\-to\-day work on process improvement, you’ll contribute to supporting deployed processes, working with our manufacturing and profiling teams to help troubleshoot issues they may encounter.


**What we’re looking for:**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on independent wet lab R\&D experience in bioscience domain.
* Masters in a Biology, Bioengineering, or a related bioscience or engineering field, or equivalent experience in industry.
* A love for carrying out lab work at the bench and keeping a lab organized and operational.
* Knowledge of Liquid Handlers and Automation equipment, including experience transferring protocols from hands\-on bench scale to more automated protocols.
* Strong scientific technical understanding of your previous wet lab biology R\&D projects.
* Experience working closely within a wet lab research and development team, and competency in experimental design and iteration.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).


**Join us if you:**
* Connect deeply with our mission, ambition and sense of duty. Our mission isn’t marketing flash: we developed our technology to better measure biology and discover biomarkers for early disease detection. We firmly believe we will be successful in literally eradicating certain diseases by enabling them to be diagnosed earlier. We also believe that our hard work to bring this technology to its full potential is our duty.
* Are up for a challenge and want to grow: We are a team of problem\-solvers, and we continually put ourselves to the test and go into the unknown. We have a growth mindset, both on hard and soft skills, and we rely on each other to give critical and candid feedback to ensure that we can all reach our full potential.
* Want to be at the cutting\-edge of biotechnology. The nELISA is a new tool that leverages DNA nanotechnology to generate proteomic data more efficiently than ever before. You get to design, build and run the system that will run the technology going forward.
* Love hands\-on lab work, and want to take hold of key learnings from experiments, and use them to develop improved analytical methods to ensure the robust biological validation of immunoassays.
* Prefer working and communicating within a diverse cross\-functional team. You would get to interface with teammates from the Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams on a daily basis, joining a collaborative, diverse, and inclusive team where your ideas will be valued.


 If you are passionate about lab work, want to drive innovation in proteomics, and are eager to make a meaningful impact in the world, we invite you to apply and join us on our journey to redefine proteomics and the understanding of biology.
   

  

**À propos de nous:**
 Nomic a été fondée dans le but de rendre la biologie plus facile à mesurer. Pour ce faire, nous avons démêlé certains des problèmes les plus difficiles dans le profilage des protéines. Notre équipe combine la nanotechnologie ADN, la cytométrie en flux à haute dimension, l'automatisation des laboratoires et l'apprentissage automatique pour développer la plateforme de protéomique la plus performante au monde : la nELISA.
   

  

 Depuis que nous avons émergé de l'Université McGill, nous avons collaboré et fourni l'accès à notre plateforme à des dizaines de groupes de découverte de médicaments, tels que GSK, 4 des 10 plus grandes entreprises pharmaceutiques et des entreprises de biotechnologie de premier plan. Nous avons récemment mis sur pied une technologie innovatrice de fabrication et de profilage de protéines qui permet la mesure multiplexée de plus de 2,5 millions d'échantillons par année, ce qui génère concrètement 500 millions d'analyse de protéines au courant du processus.
   

  

 Nous constituons une équipe diversifiée d'ingénieurs, de scientifiques et de changeurs du monde. Nous aimons décomposer les problèmes difficiles en utilisant une approche de principes fondamentaux, souvent en exploitant les plus récentes avancées scientifiques et technologiques pour faire progresser notre mission.
   

  

 Nomic a son siège social à Montréal, au Canada, avec un laboratoire de recherche satellite à Boston, dans le Massachusetts. La majorité de notre équipe est basée à Montréal et travaille dans un nouvel espace de bureau/laboratoire partagé, tandis que notre équipe de Boston se développe rapidement, avec un focus sur l'automatisation et la recherche et développement de la plateforme nELISA.
   

  

**À propos du poste:**
 L'objectif de notre équipe d'automatisation est de favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle grâce à des améliorations innovantes des processus et de la robotique, tant du côté de la fabrication que de la caractérisation de notre plateforme nELISA. En tant qu'Associé(e) en R\&D au sein de l'équipe d'automatisation, vous contribuerez au développement d'améliorations des flux de travail en utilisant des équipements d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité et la cohérence des départements de Nomic. Votre rôle aidera directement à accélérer les travaux sur notre plateforme nELISA. En particulier :
   

  

* Ce rôle impliquera une combinaison de travail au banc et d'expérimentations automatisées, ainsi qu'un travail substantiel en laboratoire général et la gestion quotidienne du laboratoire, comme l'organisation et l'enregistrement des consommables, la surveillance et la réalisation d'expériences de contrôle de qualité pour les équipements clés, et la documentation/organisation des activités avec vos coéquipiers en automatisation.
* Vous collaborerez avec la plupart des équipes de Nomic, allant des équipes de R\&D pour la conception d'expérimentations, à notre équipe logicielle pour le développement des interfaces utilisateur.
* Vous planifierez et exécuterez également de manière autonome des expériences R\&D plus ciblées, et travaillerez avec d'autres départements pour tirer parti des enseignements tirés et itérer sur la conception des expériences suivantes.
* Vous exécuterez des expériences nécessitant l'utilisation de manipulateurs de liquides avancés et de cytomètres, ainsi que d'équipements de laboratoire plus courants. En utilisant ces instruments, vous fabriquerez également des sous\-composants moléculaires nELISA pour réaliser des expériences contrôlées en laboratoire.
* Vous travaillerez avec vos coéquipiers en automatisation pour observer les opérations internes du laboratoire, en suggérant des moyens par lesquels le département d'automatisation peut aider à réduire les étapes de protocoles complexes et améliorer la fiabilité.
* Vous collaborerez entre les sites de Nomic à Montréal et à Boston, et communiquerez avec les opérateurs de laboratoire qui exécutent des protocoles robotiques à distance.
* En plus du travail quotidien sur l'amélioration des processus, vous contribuerez à soutenir les processus déployés, en travaillant avec nos équipes de fabrication et de caractérisation pour les aider à résoudre les problèmes qu'ils pourraient rencontrer.


**Ce que nous recherchons :**
* Plus de 3 ans d'expérience pratique et indépendante en R\&D en laboratoire humide dans le domaine des biosciences
* Master en Biologie, Bioingénierie ou un domaine connexe des biosciences ou de l'ingénierie, ou expérience équivalente dans l'industrie
* Passion pour le travail en laboratoire et maintien d'un laboratoire organisé et opérationnel
* Connaissance des manipulateurs de liquides et des équipements d'automatisation, y compris l'expérience de transfert de protocoles de l'échelle du banc à des protocoles plus automatisés
* Solide compréhension technique scientifique des projets de R\&D en biologie réalisés en laboratoire humide
* Expérience de travail étroite au sein d'une équipe de R\&D en laboratoire humide, et compétence en conception et itération d'expériences
* Excellentes compétences en communication (verbale et écrite)


**Joignez\-vous à notre équipe si:**
* Notre mission vous stimule, répond à vos ambitions et votre sens du devoir. Notre mission n'est pas un simple coup de publicité : nous avons développé notre technologie pour mieux mesurer la biologie et découvrir des biomarqueurs pour la détection précoce des maladies. Nous croyons fermement que nous réussirons à éradiquer littéralement certaines maladies en permettant leur diagnostic plus tôt. Nous croyons également que notre travail acharné pour amener cette technologie à son plein potentiel est notre devoir.
* Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever un défi et à grandir : nous sommes une équipe de solutionneurs de problèmes, et nous nous mettons constamment à l'épreuve et plongeons dans l'inconnu. Nous avons une mentalité de croissance, tant sur les compétences techniques que générales, et nous comptons les uns sur les autres pour donner des retours critiques et francs afin de nous assurer que nous puissions tous atteindre notre plein potentiel.
* Vous souhaitez être à la pointe de la biotechnologie. La nELISA est un nouvel outil qui exploite la nanotechnologie ADN pour générer des données protéomiques plus efficacement que jamais auparavant. Vous aurez la possibilité de concevoir, de construire et d'exploiter le système qui soutiendra l'évolution de cette technologie.
* Vous aimez le travail pratique en laboratoire, souhaitez tirer parti des apprentissages clés des expériences et les utiliser pour développer des méthodes analytiques améliorées afin d'assurer la validation biologique robuste des immunoessais.
* Vous préférez travailler et communiquer au sein d'une équipe diversifiée et multi\-disciplinaire. Vous serez en contact avec des collègues des équipes d'ingénierie, des opérations et des équipes commerciales au quotidien, rejoignant une équipe collaborative, diversifiée et inclusive où vos idées seront valorisées.


 Si vous êtes passionné(e) par le travail en laboratoire, souhaitez stimuler l'innovation en protéomique, et désirez avoir un impact significatif sur le monde, nous vous invitons à postuler et à nous rejoindre dans notre mission de redéfinir la protéomique et la compréhension de la biologie.

title: Automation Project Engineer
description:
Title: Automation Project Engineer
 
  




**Position Overview**

 We are seeking a highly motivated and versatile engineer to join our dynamic team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in the fast\-paced and ever\-evolving field of automation engineering. You will be engaged in various aspects of automation, including electrical design, PLC programming, HMI screen design, and automation software development. The ideal candidate will have a broad skill set, a passion for innovative technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines. This role will provide invaluable exposure to different engineering fields and require you to understand mechanical or process systems to optimize their operation through advanced control strategies.
   




**Key Responsibilities**
* **Project Participation and Leadership:** 
 Lead and manage small to medium\-sized automation projects from concept to completion. Coordinate the work of cross\-functional teams, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. Provide guidance to junior engineers and technicians, fostering teamwork and professional development.
* **Electrical Design Support:** 
 Assist in creating detailed electrical CAD drawings for instrumentation and control systems. Ensure designs meet project specifications, regulatory standards, and industry best practices, with an emphasis on safety and efficiency.
* **PLC Programming** 
 : Develop, test, and implement PLC programs to control automation systems, focusing on performance optimization, reliability, and scalability. Ensure that all programming meets the required safety, reliability, and operational standards.
* **HMI Design:** 
 Design intuitive and user\-friendly HMI (Human\-Machine Interface) screens to facilitate smooth control and monitoring of automation systems. Maintain high standards of usability, clarity, and functionality, making sure that operators can quickly interpret system status and take appropriate actions.
* **Automation Software Development** 
 : Participate in the development, testing, and deployment of automation software solutions. Ensure integration with PLCs, HMIs, sensors, and other control systems for seamless operation. Collaborate on software architecture and design to enhance system performance.
* **System Integration** 
 : Work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth integration of electrical, mechanical, and software components into a unified automation solution. This includes coordinating with teams across departments to ensure full alignment of system requirements and functional capabilities.
* **Troubleshooting and Support** 
 : Provide hands\-on technical support for commissioning, startup, and troubleshooting of automation systems. Offer both on\-site and remote support, quickly diagnosing issues and implementing solutions to minimize downtime.
* **Documentation** 
 : Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for all designs, programs, and system configurations. Ensure documentation is clear, complete, and up to date for internal stakeholders and future reference.
* **Continuous Improvement** 
 : Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering practices by researching and adopting emerging technologies in the automation field. Share knowledge and best practices to help improve team performance and system capabilities.
* **Safety and Compliance** 
 : Ensure all designs, systems, and operations adhere to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Foster a culture of safety and compliance within the engineering team.
* **Project Management** 
 : Take ownership of automation projects, including managing project timelines, budgets, and resources. Develop detailed project plans, track milestones, and ensure that project deliverables are completed to specifications. Communicate project progress and updates to stakeholders regularly.
* **Client Interaction and Reporting** 
 : Interface with clients to understand their project requirements, provide technical guidance, and present project updates. Ensure that clients are kept informed and satisfied with project milestones, deliverables, and results.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 3\-7 years of experience in an engineering or technical role, with exposure to PLC programming, HMI design, electrical design, and software development.


**Skills**
* Basic proficiency in CAD software for electrical design
* Hands\-on experience with PLC programming or coding
* Familiarity with control and process systems
* Knowledge of software development and system integration
* Willingness to learn multi\-disciplines
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team\-oriented environment
* Project Management experience



  





 This is a Hybrid Position that requires local travel within New England. Applicant must reside within this area.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

 We are Silicon Labs. We are a leader in secure, intelligent wireless technology for a more connected world. The RAIL team develops the Radio Abstraction Interface Layer (RAIL) SDK, which provides an intuitive and customizable radio interface designed to support both proprietary and standards\-based wireless protocols. Customers leverage our unified radio software API to efficiently create wireless applications without needing to master device\-specific details. This allows for the development of innovative IoT\-based wireless devices, ranging from low\-power battery\-operated applications to complex multi\-protocol system. Learn more about the IoT solutions you will work on and our company culture on Glassdoor.

 As an Embedded Software Engineer I on the RAIL team at Silicon Labs \- Boston, you will:

* Design, implement, and maintain radio physical and MAC layer code, system startup code, peripheral drivers, security, and system test and verification programs

* Experience driving work through the full software development lifecycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and deployment

This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 We are a small, established frontend software team specialized in data layer integration and visualization looking for engineers passionate about rendering, computational geometry, and related fields. From day one, you will be working on web\-based 3D tools for use at Gecko client sites, collaborating closely with our customer\-specific deployments to drive real change in government and industry. You will work with other software teams to integrate new photogrammetric and point\-cloud data layers into Gecko’s Cantilever™ software platform, driving digitization at factories, power plants, and navy bases. You will innovate with new technologies and datasets, including server\-side rendering and satellite overlays as we build the next generation of site, fleet, and asset management tools.
   

  

**Technologies We Use**
 Cantilever™ applications are built in Typescript\+React, using ThreeJS (WebGL) for procedural, client\-side rendering and a blend of Unreal and other technologies for server\-side rendering. Data processing services are written in Python, while GCP is our cloud provider. We are tech\-agnostic in our interview process, so we encourage you to apply regardless of your background.

 At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health and wellness support, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off.

title: Sustaining Quality Engineer
description:
To reinvent an industry, you have to build the best team.
 **Join Formlabs** 
 if you want to bring groundbreaking professional 3D printers to the desktop of every designer, engineer, researcher, and artist in the world.
   

  

 Formlabs products combine electro\-mechanical, thermal, fluidic, optical, chemical, and embedded systems to turn computer models into tangible goods. Sustaining Quality engineers are exposed to the full array of subsystems that make Formlabs products reliable and easy to use. This role is broad, spanning field failure analysis, product design revision, test engineering, supplier quality management, and customer service enablement. Sitting within the Product Integrity (quality) organization, Sustaining Quality Engineers interact with customer\-facing teams, product managers, product development engineers, manufacturing engineers, sourcing specialists, and suppliers. Data collection and analysis are central to prioritizing work, making decisions, measuring performance, and reporting progress, and our work links directly to the company's bottom line. If you are a generalist engineer, have a passion for data, and enjoy tying your work to boosting customer satisfaction, then join Formlabs’ Product Integrity team as a
 **Sustaining Quality Engineer** 
 .
   

  

**The Job**
* Perform hands\-on and data\-driven root cause analysis of product failure modes utilizing structured problem\-solving methodologies
* Design, implement, and validate product changes to enhance product performance, reliability, ease of use, or cost
* Partner with contract manufacturing partners to develop and implement quality control strategies, ensuring the quality of finished products from piece\-part component to arrival at a customer’s door
* Develop and/or issue corrective and preventive actions resulting from nonconforming material escapes to maintain Formlabs’ high\-quality standards
* Build expertise in Formlabs' 3D printing technology while collaborating with R\&D teams on risk assessment, design reviews, product enhancements, and validation testing


**You**
* Have demonstrated experience owning projects over discrete tasks. Can take an ambiguous problem and scope, plan and execute a solution considering various factors from customer experience to operational and design constraints.
* Skilled in investigating complex systems to root cause failure modes across multiple domains \- mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing
* Are well\-versed in analyzing data to pick out trends, compare populations, monitor processes, and model system behavior
* Can prototype and run your own tests, from experimental design, sample selection, test fixture development and hands\-on implementation
* Exposure to reading and understanding mechanical drawings, 3D CAD systems, electrical troubleshooting tools, and/or mass production manufacturing processes
* Strong technical documentation skills
* A passion for learning new skills, delving into complex technical problems, and building collaborative relationships


**Bonus Skills**
* Scripting ability, including python, SQL, bash, and related data analysis tools
* Prior experience in electrical or mechanical design, embedded systems, manufacturing, quality control, or integration engineering
* Training in Lean, Six Sigma, 8D or other structured problem\-solving methodologies
* Previous work with contract manufacturing partners utilizing high\-volume production processes such as tooled sheet metal, die casting, injection molding, extrusion, SMT PCB assembly


**Our Perks \& Benefits**
* Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors
* Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
* Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
* Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
* Ample on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats
* Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
* Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community

title: Staff Robotic System Engineer
description:
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $12 billion in FY23 and approximately 26,000 people globally working alongside 125,000 global customers, ADI ensures today’s innovators stay Ahead of What’s Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn.
   

  

 The Dexterous AI Group (DAG) is seeking a Staff Robotic System Engineer in Boston to design, develop, and integrate advanced robotics hardware for AI innovations. Responsibilities include leading system\-level architecture design, developing custom PCB assemblies, evaluating components, integrating hardware, validating performance, troubleshooting, and collaborating with software and AI teams. Qualifications include a master’s degree in a related field, 5\+ years of experience in system design and robotics, proficiency in PCB design tools, strong programming skills, and familiarity with robotic systems and debugging tools.
   

  

 The Dexterous AI Group (DAG) is looking for an experienced robotic system engineer to design, develop, and integrate advanced robotics hardware solutions for core AI innovations in the robotic space. This role will focus on the system\-level architecture, PCB\-level implementation, and hardware integration of robotic platforms, sensors, and control systems. You will collaborate closely with software engineers, AI researchers, and cross\-functional teams to bring robust, high\-performance robotic solutions from concept to reality.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Lead the design and rapid prototyping of system\-level architectures for next\-generation robotic platforms with novel sensors, actuators, and control.
* Design and develop custom PCB assemblies
* Evaluate subsystems, components, materials, and processes
* Select and integrate critical hardware components (e.g., processors, sensors, actuators) to meet performance, cost, and reliability targets.
* Validate and calibrate hardware for performance and integrity.
* Identify and troubleshoot system\-level issues related to electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance.
* Rapid iteration based on test results, performance metrics, and user feedback.
* Collaborate with mechanical, software, and AI teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software components.
* Work closely with software and AI engineers to develop hardware systems for advanced AI algorithms and real\-time control.
* Prepare technical documentation, including schematics, assembly instructions, and design reviews.
* Stay current with the latest advancements in robotics hardware, sensors, and AI\-driven control architectures.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of full\-time experience in system design, integration, electro\-mechanical systems, particularly in robotics.
* Proficiency in PCB design tools, such as Cadence Allegro, and hardware design methodologies.
* Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and Python, and familiarity with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and real\-time operating systems (RTOS).
* Familiarity with robotic systems (sensors and actuators), system integration, and robotic software such as ROS2\.
* Experience with hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, etc.).
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, a proactive approach to cross\-disciplinary challenges, and collaborative working style in fast\-paced, innovative environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex hardware concepts to non\-hardware audiences.
* Preferred: familiarity with robotic control systems, kinematics, and motion planning. applied AI and machine learning

**What Categories of Veterans Are “Protected” by VEVRAA?**
 “Protected” veterans include the following categories: (1\) disabled veterans; (2\) recently separated veterans; (3\) active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans; and (4\) Armed Forces service medal veterans. These categories are defined below.
   

  

* A “disabled veteran” is one of the following:
* a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or
* a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service\-connected disability.
* A “recently separated veteran” means any veteran during the three\-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
* An “active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran” means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
* An “Armed forces service medal veteran” means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985\.

title: Principal Analog Methodology Specialist
description:
We Are:
   

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are:
   

  

 You are an experienced and passionate Analog Methodology Engineer with a deep understanding of mixed\-signal circuit design principles. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with a cross\-functional team of experts. Your hands\-on experience with transistor\-level simulations, reliability analysis, and static timing analysis (STA) tools sets you apart. You are proficient in scripting and automation, enabling you to streamline design processes and mentor junior engineers. Your knowledge spans across various analog and mixed\-signal circuits, and you have a strong background in silicon IP release requirements. Your communication skills are top\-notch, and you are self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and committed to excellence. You bring a wealth of experience to the table, making you a key player in driving innovation and achieving success.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing:
   

  

* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team of analog and mixed\-signal circuit designers on design and methodology.
* Conducting transistor\-level simulations and reliability analysis to ensure the robustness of designs.
* Utilizing static timing analysis (STA) tools to validate and optimize circuit performance.
* Developing and automating design flows using programming languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, and C/C\+\+.
* Leading and mentoring junior engineers to become proficient in new methodologies and best practices.
* Driving the integration of high\-speed PHY designs such as SERDES, DDR, or HBM into SoCs.


 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Enhancing the quality and reliability of our analog and mixed\-signal IP through rigorous simulations and analysis.
* Streamlining design processes and reducing time\-to\-market with automation and efficient methodologies.
* Contributing to the success of high\-performance computing (HPC) projects by providing expertise in analog and mixed\-signal design.
* Empowering junior engineers to grow and excel in their roles through mentorship and training.
* Driving innovation and excellence in analog and mixed\-signal circuit design at Synopsys.
* Ensuring seamless integration of our IP into customer SoCs, reducing integration risks and enhancing customer satisfaction.


 What You’ll Need:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field; MSEE or PhD preferred.
* 18\-25 years of experience in IC design with a BSEE degree, or 15\-18 years with an MSEE or PhD.
* Extensive programming skills in Python, Perl, TCL, and C/C\+\+.
* Proficiency with spice simulators including HSPICE, PrimeSim/FineSim, and XA.
* Deep knowledge of analog and mixed\-signal circuit design principles and methodologies.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* A collaborative team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and committed to delivering high\-quality work.
* Skilled in leading and mentoring junior engineers to achieve their full potential.
* Innovative and proactive in finding solutions to complex design challenges.
* Adaptable and able to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


 The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
   

  

 Our Solution IP group is dedicated to ramping up high\-performance computing (HPC) demand. You will be working with a diverse, cross\-functional team of analog and mixed\-signal circuit designers. Together, we focus on delivering high\-quality, innovative IP solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.
